title: Alchemy
blurb: A skyblock in the void, after SkyFactory 3. One tree, then compost, sieves, furnaces, crucibles and cobblestone generators, all the way to the Philosopher's Stone.

title: The Blog
blurb: Math notes from the Institute: Dirichlet's theorem via Euler products, inclusion-exclusion on the way to Möbius, and an unintuitive guide to linear algebra where dimension is the length of the longest flag.

title: Dots & Boxes
blurb: Draw lines, close squares, get double-crossed. Play against Amog himself, who has read Berlekamp and will not hesitate.

title: Nim & Friends
blurb: Nim, Fibonacci Nim, Wythoff's queen, Kayles, Staircase Nim, Northcott's game, subtraction games and Blue-Red Hackenbush, against an Amog who plays perfectly. Set up your own starting positions, or turn on "show the math" to see why he wins.

title: Whack-a-Moni
blurb: You are Redstone. Moni keeps surfacing with a banana. Bonk him, build a combo, and under no circumstances bonk Megumin or Shiro.

title: Amog Space Program
blurb: An incremental game about rockets with real physics: the Tsiolkovsky equation, drag, staging. Start with a soda-bottle rocket, end with a colony ship to Andromeda.

title: Axis Order
blurb: The Axis Order incremental. Gather faith, spread pamphlets, and ascend until Amog I is satisfied.
